contrastMethod.scope: Explicit visible primary and secondary text samples in Summary and Expenses, dark and light themes; themed tooltips separately.
contrastMethod.method: Independent sRGB luminance and alpha-composited solid ancestor backgrounds; 4.5:1 normal, 3:1 at >=24px or >=18.6667px bold>=700. Wait for opaque stable ancestors before sampling; do not modify CSS.

keyboard: Expense labels, independent clear action name, Tab order, Space checkbox and Enter submission; Settings tab ARIA and focus indicator; tooltip focus/Escape. Search accessible name may contain its nested Clear search action; it must start with the visible label.
modalIssue: Initial focus, accessible dialog title and centered close icon pass. Tab then escapes the modal, and closing with Escape does not restore the opener. Complete project/persistence remain unchanged. Active failure in both engines, not a timeout or browser-specific claim.
collapsedNavigationIssue: Five primary navigation buttons become unnamed after collapsing the sidebar: their label spans are display:none and the buttons have no aria-label. Icons remain visible and geometry/data checks pass. Final assertion records all five zero accessible-name matches explicitly rather than timing out in the navigation helper; sidebar then expands to finish balance checks.
reducedMotion: MatchMedia plus public read-only effects status and button transition durations <=1ms. CSS may use 0.01ms to preserve end events. Scrolling uses a content margin so the inner table does not consume the wheel event.
network: All external requests blocked. Offline preference only initialized if absent. No market data dependency.
developmentNotes: Search label equality initially too strict: its nested Clear search action contributes text. Final test requires visible label prefix and independent action name; no missing label is ignored.
Reduced-motion duration initially required literal 0s. Final check accepts <=1ms, keeping almost-zero event-preserving CSS valid.
Contrast measurement initially raced entry opacity; final predicate waits for supported solid opaque rendering with the same ratio thresholds.
One currency only scrolls the inner table. Final scroll fixture adds two empty currencies and targets the main content margin.

A development run lost one Node worker with native exit code 3221226505 before TC188 body (0ms). Cause undetermined; not classified as an app assertion or attributed to Chromium. Final full suite and independent Edge run are separate, no configured retries.
scope: Nine final cases run together after development corrections, plus five independent Edge cases. Earlier evidence is historical; not a combined run of all 195. No app changes, golden screenshot baselines, full axe/WCAG audit, mobile certification or native EXE validation.
